quotes.author: Zelda S. Mar 8
quotes.text: Wow, what can I say? I had the time of my life! My daughter treated me for my birthday, and I would go again and again. It was truly a thrill of a lifetime. I would love to take another flight and experience those breathtaking views all over again. Such a memorable experience!

quotes.author: Daime Quintana Jun 22
quotes.text: Had a wonderful time this weekend on our seaplane and dine experience. This was a Father’s Day surprise for my husband and something we have wanted to do for years. An unforgettable experience!

quotes.author: Maddie M Feb 28
quotes.text: Thank you for the wonderful ride! Our pilot Tony was the coolest and his experience shows!
